world.title: Zylos
world.aphorism: It fails in ways that teach.

closing: A clean result may describe the rule more clearly than it describes the world.

beats.say: Trurl builds an empire in a box, and an engine that answers every gain with a harder push.
The empire spreads hex by hex. At twenty seconds the invaders come, and every six seconds they push harder.
Forts slow them down. For a while, half the land is held.

acts.fn: const own = V.hexes.filter(h => h.owner === 1).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - 400, a.y - 240) - Math.hypot(b.x - 400, b.y - 240)); return own.slice(0, 8).map(h => [h.x, h.y]);

beats.say: Then the engine breaks the empire, as it was built to do.
It fails in ways that teach.
You do not win this box. You learn where it breaks.
